title: fix(scaffold): a scaffolded namespace fits the customization-pair cap, so a fresh project from a long name validates with no warning
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XWpxb51mia4Ts4VrhocktU6)_

Fixes #28992

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`npx create-objectstack` 和 `os init` 由项目名生成命名空间时,上限从 20 个字符改为 13 个(即 `MAX_CUSTOMIZATION_BASE_NAMESPACE_LENGTH`)。`qa-console-first-paint` 现在得到 `qa_console_fi`,脚手架里的对象名和文件名都跟着它走;截断后不留结尾的 `_`。13 个字符以内的项目名,生成结果与以前逐字节相同。
- 为什么改:超过 13 个字符的命名空间没有配对的定制命名空间(ADR-0146 D3),所以新人刚生成的项目第一次 `os validate` 就弹出 `namespace-no-customization-pair` 警告,让他去改不是他写的对象名。
- 风险与回滚:只影响新生成的项目,已有项目不变。`create-objectstack` 运行时不依赖 spec,所以保留一份本地常量,由测试钉死等于 spec 的常量;`os init` 直接读 spec 常量。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/create-objectstack/src/rewrite-identity.ts` 的 `SCAFFOLD_NAMESPACE_MAX_LENGTH` 与 `sanitizeNamespace()`(从 index.ts 原样搬来,只改上限);`packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` 的 `sanitizeNamespace()`;`packages/create-objectstack/src/scaffold-namespace-cap.test.ts` 的常量相等钉。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter create-objectstack exec vitest run src/scaffold-namespace-cap.test.ts src/scaffold-namespace-customization-pair.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 44 passed (44)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/create-objectstack/src/rewrite-identity.ts`**: `sanitizeNamespace()` moves here from `index.ts`, beside its sibling `deriveManifestId()`, so it can be unit tested (`index.ts` calls `program.parse()` on import). The only behaviour change is the cap: `SCAFFOLD_NAMESPACE_MAX_LENGTH = 13` replaces the three `20`s. The existing trailing-`_` strip after truncation is kept, so a namespace whose 13th character is `_` ends one character earlier.
- **Why a local constant in create-objectstack (measured).** The order asked to read `MAX_CUSTOMIZATION_BASE_NAMESPACE_LENGTH` from one place if the scaffolder can depend on it cheaply. `@objectstack/spec` is only a devDependency of create-objectstack. A value import from `src/` would be bundled into the published scaffolder, and `check:undeclared-dep-imports` refuses exactly that (a devDependency inlined into published source). Making the spec a runtime dependency would add `zod` and `pg-connection-string` to a two-dependency `npx` entry point. Bundle size was not the obstacle: an esbuild probe from spec source gives 3,121 bytes and no zod. So the order's fallback applies: a local constant, pinned equal to the spec constant by `scaffold-namespace-cap.test.ts`, which resolves `@objectstack/spec/kernel` to source through the package's existing vitest alias.
- **`packages/create-objectstack/src/index.ts`**: imports `sanitizeNamespace` from `./rewrite-identity.js`. The namespace is still computed once (`const namespace = sanitizeNamespace(projectName)`) and handed to the manifest, the config and the object-prefix rewrite, so every derived name uses the truncated value.
- **`packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts`** (`os init`): the same function had the same 20 cap. It now reads `MAX_CUSTOMIZATION_BASE_NAMESPACE_LENGTH` from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`, a runtime dependency of the CLI already. The seat widened the claim to cover it, so the two scaffolders keep agreeing.
- **`.changeset/28992-scaffold-namespace-pair-cap.md`**: `create-objectstack` patch and `@objectstack/cli` patch, with both declaration lines. Nothing newly exported from `@objectstack/spec`. The `create-objectstack` `index.ts` export of `sanitizeNamespace` is not in its `exports` map (only `./created-summary` is), so no published surface moved.

## Tests

- **Red first, unit (real scaffold).** New `scaffold-namespace-customization-pair.test.ts` drives the real CLI through `tsx` for `qa-console-first-paint`. On the unchanged code it failed with `Expected: "qa_console_fi"`, `Received: "qa_console_first_pai"`. Green, it asserts that the namespace is `qa_console_fi`, that `customizationNamespace()` (the helper the lint rule and the ensure door use) answers `{ ok: true, value: 'qa_console_fi_custom' }`, that the config literal matches, and that every scaffolded object name passes `validateObjectNamespacePrefix`.
- **New `scaffold-namespace-cap.test.ts`** (43 cases):
  - the constant equals `MAX_CUSTOMIZATION_BASE_NAMESPACE_LENGTH`;
  - for 27 names (empty, single character, reserved, scoped, digit-leading, Unicode, exactly 13, 14, 26 characters), the result passes `ManifestSchema.shape.namespace`, is not reserved, and has a customization pair;
  - truncation cases, including the 13th character being `_` (`abcdefghijkl-mnop` → `abcdefghijkl`) and a digit-leading name (`1234567890123456` → `a123456789012`);
  - controls: names that already fit (`my-app`, `crm`, `abcdefghijklm`, `thirteen-char`, `''`, `x`, `9-lives`, `sys`, `system`, `@acme/my-app`) keep their previous value.
- **cli `test/init.test.ts`**: five truncation cases and one customization-pair sweep added to its `sanitizeNamespace` block.
- **Real `os validate` (red and green), on scaffolds under `packages/cli/node_modules/.probe-28992/`, run with the built `packages/cli/bin/run.js`:**
  - main's `index.ts` (from `0be247ce`): namespace `qa_console_first_pai`, `os validate` exit 0 with 1 `namespace-no-customization-pair` warning ("namespace "qa_console_first_pai" is 20 characters …").
  - this branch: namespace `qa_console_fi`, `os validate` exit 0, 0 occurrences of the rule and 0 `⚠` lines.
  - `os init qa-console-first-paint --no-install` on this branch: `Namespace: qa_console_fi`, object file `qa_console_fi_item.object.ts`, `os validate` exit 0 with no `namespace-no-customization-pair`. (It prints the pre-existing `⚠ No apps or plugins defined` for the `app` template, which does not depend on the namespace.)
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit once each; restore proved by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`):
  - create-objectstack, `SCAFFOLD_NAMESPACE_MAX_LENGTH = 13` → `20` (blob `8fb4bd56` → `3a388a6f`): `pnpm --filter create-objectstack test` reds 15 failed / 330 passed, in the 2 new files only, while the 19 existing files stay green. The red cases are the constant pin, the 8 long names in the pair sweep, the 5 truncation cases, and the real-scaffold case.
  - cli, `const max = MAX_CUSTOMIZATION_BASE_NAMESPACE_LENGTH` → `const max = 20` (blob `ef45f599` → `a44b2c1f`): the five init suites red 5 failed / 118 passed, exactly the 4 new truncation cases and the pair sweep. The exact-fit control stays green.
  - No build was on either path: both suites import the changed file as relative source.
- **Package suites** at `c422fbc2` (the follow-up `51ac52ae` changes one comment line in a test): `pnpm --filter create-objectstack test` 21 files / 345 tests passed, and its `typecheck` (which includes `src/**/*.test.ts`) passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` passed, and `vitest run --project unit` passed 368 files / 5,202 tests. The cli `integration` layer is left to CI: no integration-layer file or spawn entry is touched.

## Acceptance notes

- No "namespace was shortened" line was added. `create-objectstack` and `os init` already print `Namespace: VALUE` before writing, and the value is now the truncated one. A separate notice would need the untruncated value threaded out of `sanitizeNamespace()`, which is more than the order's "only if trivial".
- `docs/audits/2026-09-os-create-os-init-convergence-measurement.md` mentions `sanitizeNamespace()` in a dated audit table. Its claim (one call site, the config namespace) still holds, so it was left as is.

## Verification

Head `51ac52ae`.

- **Derived gate families** (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, change set vs merge base `0be247ce8`): 62 derived. 60 ran green (exit 0). 2 NOT MEASURED, reason: prerequisite, because they read every package's built output and only the CLI closure was built here: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` (exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`). CI runs both. Reconciliation: `dispatch-gates --ran` → `62 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 60 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED`.
- One real red, fixed on this branch: `check:cross-package-test-inputs` read a repo path spelled in a test comment (`packages/lint/src/…`) as an undeclared input of the new real-scaffold test. The comment now names the rule by its export (`51ac52ae`), and the gate passes: `OK: 31 package(s) read outside themselves, all declared`.
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 because the shallow clone could not reach its pinned fixture commit. After `git fetch --depth=1` of that commit it passed (48 cases).
- `test:repo` was not run locally (no file of that project is touched). CI's Test Core covers it.
